firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently tamed an animal in Minecraft starts.
clarifications: If nobody qualifies, the youngest player begins. The starting player receives the white Illagers die during setup.

sources.title: Minecraft: Heroes of the Village — English rules

internalEvidence: Ravensburger's US product page https://www.ravensburger.us/en-US/pdp/20914 links this 44-page multilingual manual. The English cover identifies article 20914. PDF page 3 assigns the Illagers die to the starter and PDF page 4 states the animal-taming criterion and youngest-player fallback. Page 4 was rendered and read visually. ©2022 is on the product page.
